# single.de

> > single.de is a German online dating platform and singles community operated by free communication GmbH, connecting over 2 million members for relationships, flirting, and chat since 2001.

single.de offers comprehensive dating services including a Singlebörse (singles exchange), Partnervermittlung (matchmaking), and mobile dating app with free registration. The platform serves the German-speaking market with features for relationship-seeking, casual dating, and social connections.
